construction.generated-material-parts.evidence: focused GUI.Forms material test proves bounded pointer/count stop, fill, shadow, and border construction with retained ownership

construction.generated-control-state-rec.evidence: GUI.Forms ButtonBase owns a validated retained ControlStateRecipes set; focused tests prove normal, hot, pressed, disabled, whole-visual translation, and external focus geometry
construction.generated-control-state-rec.fallback: use the named GUI.Forms theme role and report the authored-state loss

construction.generated-native-tree.evidence: experimental Stage 2 composes only exact manifest-backed material, layout, typography, state, and decoration projections into one deterministic typed retained tree; focused dogfood compile tests and a linked 38-node structure/layout probe pass
construction.generated-native-tree.fallback: none; refuse the entire tree when any retained node cannot be projected

decoration.before.evidence: Control owns bounded pointer/count decorations in a before-content retained paint layer; focused native and generated-code tests prove ordering with the symmetric after-content layer

decoration.after.evidence: Control owns bounded pointer/count decorations in an after-content retained paint layer; live owner-relative anchors, rotation, symmetric before/after ordering, semantic exclusion, and atomic invalid rejection have focused coverage
decoration.after.fallback: none for semantic geometry; explicit text separator may be authored separately

effect.bounded-shadow.evidence: SurfaceMaterial bounded outer shadows are generated exactly, retained in display chunks, and covered by material/damage tests

effect.inset-shadow.evidence: SurfaceMaterial retains inset identity; display chunks preserve it and a pixel-checked Skia CPU smoke test proves the live rounded complement remains clipped to its owner

geometry.rounded-corners.evidence: generated SurfaceMaterial corner radii retain rounded clip, fill, border, focus, and shadow geometry

identity.typed-hierarchical.evidence: native tree Stage 2 requires every retained node id, rejects normalized member collisions, emits one typed member per id, and the linked 38-node probe verifies exact StableId preservation

layout.flex.evidence: FlowLayoutPanel publishes retained direction, wrapping, bounded gaps, main/cross alignment, padding, and per-child grow; focused tests prove live-frame center, space-between, stretch, and ratio growth

layout.grid.evidence: TableLayoutPanel publishes bounded absolute, weighted fraction, auto tracks, retained inter-track spacing, deterministic cells, and fill docking; focused tests prove gap-aware fractional resolution

paint.linear-gradient.evidence: MaterialFillLayer, retained multi-stop linear gradients, and generated pointer/count stop construction are composed by native tree Stage 2

paint.css-angle-gradient.evidence: MaterialFillLayer CSS-angle geometry resolves gradient-line endpoints from current rectangular bounds and is covered by a focused retained paint test

paint.radial-gradient.evidence: MaterialFillLayer and measured elliptical radial gradients exist

paint.side-border.evidence: SurfaceMaterial publishes independently retained square-edge borders; rounded edge joins and mixed shorthand cascade expansion remain refused

paint.uniform-border.evidence: SurfaceMaterial publishes a retained uniform MaterialBorder
paint.uniform-border.fallback: omit only when the authored width is zero

state.active.evidence: GUI.Forms retained pressed state selects generated owned recipes; Web.Forms bounds whole-visual translate state projection
state.active.fallback: base style with reported state-material degradation

state.focus-visible.evidence: Window retains keyboard/pointer/semantic focus-cue modality independently of actual focus; ButtonBase and derived controls use it for authored focus outlines and visual outsets
state.focus-visible.fallback: none for the bounded button focus-visible profile

state.hover.evidence: GUI.Forms retained hot state selects generated owned recipes through its existing pointer state machine
state.hover.fallback: base style with reported state-material degradation

surface.authored-material.evidence: SurfaceMaterial plus the Control authored-background hook exist, bounded construction is measured, and the experimental generator publishes exact/refused base-surface projections
surface.authored-material.fallback: named GUI.Forms baseline role with reported loss

surface.nested-ambient-context.evidence: Stage 1 records owned/revealed edges; native tree Stage 2 applies authored layers to the same retained layout owner, clears Forms-default margins/padding to CSS initial values, and the linked standard-shell probe proves nested shell/grid composition

transform.rotate.evidence: Control owner-decoration recipes retain bounded rotation around the CSS-default box center and recompute endpoints from live owner geometry

transform.translate.evidence: generated button recipes project one logical translate/translateX/translateY up to 32px as a paint-only whole-visual offset with measured outsets

typography.bundled-font-pack.evidence: GUI.Forms registers bundled Carlito, Cousine, and Portsmouth Rapids faces by stable role; Web.Forms admits only matching local @font-face declarations

typography.retained.evidence: Label and ButtonBase retain font size, weight, italic state, letter spacing, line spacing, alignment, and bounded text case projection; Label retains foreground and wrapping
